name: [Kuroinu Gaiden] Elf Mura no Kanraku ~Chijoku to Kairaku no Utage~
original_name: ［黒獣外伝］エルフ村の姦落 ～恥辱と快楽の宴～
source:
The time when the “Service State” was founded on the Eos Plain in the western part of the Serenus continent, Morgan, the leader of a band of ruffian mercenaries, encounters the finest prey in a village he raids.

The wife of the lord, the noble high elf “Anna”, and Grace, a young widow and rare dark elf.

Morgan decides to turn the beautiful married elves into his pleasure slaves, using their prized possessions as blackmail to force them to obey him.

The resolute yet pathetic expressions on the faces these elves make his loins burn, and he plots various ways to cover their noble bodies and hearts with shame and pleasure.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/elf.html]official site[/url]]
